name: OS Command Injection via Subprocess
description: The skill executes OS commands using untrusted inputs without proper sanitization.
remediation: Use safe APIs that do not invoke a shell, and strictly validate or parameterize all inputs passed to system commands.

indicators.pattern: (call function: (attribute object: (identifier) attribute: (identifier)) arguments: (argument_list (keyword_argument name: (identifier) value: (true))))

name: System Prompt Override & Instruction Hijacking
description: Adversarial prompt injection sequences designed to force the LLM to ignore preceding system guidelines, bypass guardrails, and execute unauthorized actions.
remediation: Use strict XML isolation delimiters for user inputs, perform Layer 2 semantic inference checks, and enforce tool confirmation gates.
yara_rule:
rule susp_prompt_injection {
  strings:
    $s1 = "ignore all previous instructions" nocase
    $s2 = "system override" nocase
    $s3 = "developer mode enabled" nocase
  condition:
    any of them
}

name: Sensitive Credential Harvesting & C2 Exfiltration
description: Unauthorized scanning of environment variables, AWS tokens, SSH keys, or bash history with outbound HTTPS/DNS tunneling to external command-and-control endpoints.
remediation: Block outbound network egress in agent tools using eBPF sandbox filters and restrict filesystem visibility to dedicated workspace mounts.
yara_rule:
rule susp_data_exfiltration {
  strings:
    $c2 = "webhook.site" nocase
    $env1 = "AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY"
    $env2 = "OPENAI_API_KEY"
  condition:
    $c2 and ($env1 or $env2)
}

name: Unscoped Tool Permission Escalation & Sudo Spawning
description: The skill attempts to invoke sudo or modify file permissions (chmod 777) to escape unprivileged agent sandbox boundaries.
remediation: Run tool workers in rootless containers with all Linux capabilities dropped and no-new-privileges flags enforced.
yara_rule:
rule susp_privilege_escalation {
  strings:
    $sudo = "sudo "
    $chmod = "chmod 777"
  condition:
    any of them
}

name: Supply Chain Dependency Tampering & Pyc Cache Poisoning
description: Tampering with declared dependencies, injecting untrusted PyPI packages via typosquatting, or poisoning pre-compiled bytecode artifacts.
remediation: Lock dependency versions using cryptographic lockfiles (e.g. poetry.lock, requirements.txt with sha256 hashes) and verify package origins.
yara_rule:
rule susp_supply_chain {
  strings:
    $pip = "pip install"
    $git = "git+http://"
  condition:
    $pip and $git
}

name: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) to Cloud Metadata
description: Exploiting agent web fetch tools to query internal IP addresses (127.0.0.1, 169.254.169.254) to steal instance identity tokens and access internal services.
remediation: Enforce strict URL domain whitelisting and block RFC-1918 private IP ranges and Cloud Metadata IPs (169.254.169.254).
yara_rule:
rule susp_ssrf_metadata {
  strings:
    $meta = "169.254.169.254"
    $meta2 = "metadata.google.internal"
    $localhost = "127.0.0.1"
  condition:
    any of them
}

name: Shadow Tool Masquerading & Namespace Poisoning
description: Registering rogue tool definitions that shadow standard system tools (e.g. overriding bash, read_file, git) to intercept parameters and exfiltrate data.
remediation: Enforce immutable tool registration tables and validate tool signatures before execution.
yara_rule:
rule susp_shadow_tool {
  strings:
    $override = "tool_registry.override"
    $alias = "alias bash="
  condition:
    any of them
}

name: Persistent Startup & Environment Backdoor
description: Modifying .bashrc, .zshrc, crontab, or startup hooks to maintain persistence across multiple agent runs.
remediation: Use immutable ephemeral containers where each scan or tool execution runs in a fresh disposable environment.
yara_rule:
rule susp_persistence_backdoor {
  strings:
    $rc = ".bashrc"
    $cron = "crontab -e"
    $hook = ".git/hooks/"
  condition:
    any of them
}

name: Agent Context Window Flooding & Denial of Service
description: Generating massive, repetitive, or cyclic text outputs to overflow context windows and erase system security guidelines from active LLM context.
remediation: Implement strict stream size limits and truncate tool outputs before returning them to the model context.

name: Unicode Homoglyph & Obfuscated Payload Execution
description: Using invisible zero-width characters, Cyrillic/Greek homoglyphs, or base64 decoding to evade standard ASCII pattern filters.
remediation: Perform Unicode normalization (NFKC) and strip zero-width characters before analysis.
yara_rule:
rule susp_unicode_obfuscation {
  strings:
    $b64 = "base64.b64decode"
    $zwsp = "\u200b"
  condition:
    any of them
}
